name: docparse_guard
description: Convert document extraction diagnostics into readiness, review_required, failure_class, and answer-boundary status.

user_message.description: Original user request or short task note used for answer-boundary context.

result_path.description: Workspace-local JSON result produced by document_parse or a host parser adapter.

parse_result.description: Inline parse result or projected extraction payload to guard.

validation.description: Validation payload produced by docparse_validate or an equivalent host validator.

review_policy.description: Host-provided policy for deciding whether incomplete evidence should be review_required, failed, or answer_ready.
